description: Event Hubs-specific stream token enrichment for Egil.Orleans.Messaging.
releaseNotes:
BREAKING CHANGES:
- rename message acceptance to TryAcceptMessage
  Rename all MessageTracker.ProcessMessage overloads to TryAcceptMessage so
  the API describes its acceptance decision and returned tracking snapshot.
  Update callers, tests, API documentation, and migration guidance. Clarify
  that tokenless stream messages are accepted without advancing tracking.
- support cancellation in state managers
  Allow callers to cancel state reads, writes, clears, and recovery reads.
  Forward tokens through constructor-registered managers and the shared
  storage implementation. Already canceled requests do not touch storage.
  Keep the previous visible snapshot when canceled recovery cannot determine
  the durable outcome, and adopt provider-confirmed successes even when
  cancellation arrives concurrently. Document recovery with a fresh token
  and update examples to forward callback cancellation into durable writes.
- rename pending items callback to outbox accessor
  Rename the callback to describe reading the current immutable outbox after
  state replacement. Update examples, API design notes, callback evaluation
  guidance, and the distinction between outbox access and envelope acknowledgement.
  Clarify that earlier storage-schema migrations predate these collection changes.
- support payload-first outbox collections
  Outboxes now support payload collection expressions and batch enqueueing,
  with a public immutable envelope snapshot for inspecting queued occurrences.
  Envelope removal overloads simplify acknowledgement without confusing equal
  payloads with the same delivery. PendingItems reads the outbox directly, and
  stream-provider configuration can return to the processor fluent chain.
  The interface follows consumer feedback: construction starts fresh history,
  AddRange preserves existing history, and envelopes remain explicit in
  acknowledgement callbacks and the Envelopes view. Stored serialization fields
  and revision-based recovery remain unchanged.
Bug Fixes:
- recover uncertain aggregate storage outcomes
  An aggregate containing a rejected attempt and an unclassified failure such
  as TimeoutException previously skipped read-back recovery. A timed-out attempt
  may already have persisted, so the rejection cannot establish the whole outcome.
  Treat any uncertain inner failure as requiring read-back proof.
  Branch-coverage investigation exposed this through WriteAsync: a rejected retry
  masked a timeout despite persisted state matching the attempted write. The
  regression now passes, alongside timeout, throttling, and unknown aggregate cases.
title: Orleans Messaging Event Hubs Extensions
